newsitem.title: UK: Row over UK water bill fights seen- paper.
newsitem.headline: Row over UK water bill fights seen- paper.

text.p: UK's Environment Agency is proposing to block big cuts in water bills planned by the industry regulator and press instead for an increase in spending on clean-up measures, the Independent said on Thursday.

The paper said the move could reignite a dispute between Ian Byatt, the regulator, and the Environment Agency over how much discretionary environmental investment could be included in the water price regime.

Last week, Byatt announced plans to make a substantial one-off cut in water bills when the five-year price control starts in 2000, following the lead of gas and electricity regulators. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
